description: Goal: reduce review overhead by landing existing follow-up commits once in owning PRs. Wait for zaq-emb.21.1 email-regression owner in merry-iguana to finish/commit #799; do not edit its reserved paths or switch its branch. Incorporate #803 (618deb6ff capability lookup) and #804 (6ded08f75 queued-webhook guard) into PR #799 along with the independent email fix. Incorporate #802 (55863669f executor) into PR #800. Reconcile differing commit ancestry by rebase/merge with backup refs; never overwrite uncommitted changes or deferred stashes. Preserve only communication UI; no data-source card changes. Validate each resulting PR branch independently with isolated regression/notification suites plus mix q; final precommit deferred. Update GH PR descriptions and stack bases as needed so duplicate fixes occur once; coordinate before any force push, do not merge/close superseded PRs without explicit user approval. Action reuse: no new domain operations (Git/PR housekeeping only); existing fixes reused unchanged. No new application code, migrations or docs expected; test regressions inherited from source commits. Record before/after commit graph and verification in issue.
title: [zaq-emb.26] Consolidate stacked #768 fixes into owning PRs
